sloka: केशाः सूक्ष्माः समा नीला भ्रुवौ चासङ्गते मम ।वृत्ते चारोमशे जङ्घे दन्ताश्चाविरला मम ।। ६.४८.९ ।।।।
transliteration: keśāḥ sūkṣmāḥ samā nīlā bhruvau cāsaṅgate mama ।vṛtte cāromaśe jaṅghe dantāścāviralā mama ।। 6.48.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "My hair is fine and dark, my eyebrows are uniform and not joined, my shanks are round devoid of hair, and my teeth are closely set."
